_how_to_use: Paste the search URLs you want watched (upwork_search_urls) and any job-board RSS feeds (rss_feeds). Ghost reads them read-only, scores fit against what it can actually deliver, and drafts proposals ONLY when you click. A human always presses send — there is no auto-bid path by design (Upwork ToS). When the pipeline has been idle longer than idle_hours_before_sweep (and no client work is waiting), Ghost sweeps the sources once an hour by itself.
